home.title: Time tracking and CRM for freelancers, built around prepaid hours
home.lead: TimeWren is open source. Track your time, sell it to clients as prepaid hours and invoice it from the same entries. It works for one freelancer or a small team, on your own server or in our cloud.
home.heroNote: AGPL-3.0. Every feature in every install, with no licence key.

prepaid.title: Prepaid hours, built in
prepaid.body: In Denmark this is called a klippekort: a punch card for hours. A client buys a block of hours up front, and every time entry punches out the time it used. You always know what is left, and so does the client.
steps: Create a package for a client with the number of hours, the hourly rate and an expiry date if you want one. You can round every entry up to a fixed clip, for example 15 minutes.
Start the timer or log time on the client's work. TimeWren suggests the active package, and the entry is drawn from it when you save.
You get a warning when the balance runs low. The client sees hours used, hours left and every entry in their own portal, and can ask for a new package from there.
Per package, choose to stop at zero, to let it go into overdraft, or to bill the extra time at a separate rate. Approving a renewal creates the new package and a draft invoice in one step.
prepaid.shotAlt: Prepaid hour packages with used and remaining hours per client

unlocked.body: There is one edition of TimeWren, and all of it is open source. A self-hosted instance has no plans, seat limits, trials or licence keys. TimeWren Cloud runs the same code. You pay Cloud to run it for you, not to unlock anything.

data.title: Your data stays yours
points: Where it lives
Self-hosted, everything is in your own PostgreSQL database and file storage. Nothing is sent to us.
Export it
Export time entries, clients and invoices as CSV, or order a full export of your organisation as a ZIP with JSON and CSV.
No phone home

There is no usage reporting and no install counter. Analytics, error reporting, ad tags and release checks stay off until you configure them. The telemetry list names every outbound connection the app can make.

faq.title: Questions
items: Is self-hosting really free?
Yes. The self-hosted version has every feature, with no time limit, seat limit or licence key. You pay for your own server.
What does TimeWren Cloud cost?
Prices are not final yet. The pricing page shows them in EUR, USD and DKK, and Cloud opens to new accounts later.
What do I need to self-host?
A Linux server with Docker and Compose v2.24 or newer and 2 GB of RAM. For anything beyond trying it on localhost you also need a domain and TLS.
Can I move from another time tracker?
You can import earlier time entries from a CSV file with date, hours, description, project and client. There is no direct importer for other tools yet, so export to CSV from the tool you use today.
How do I back it up?
The repository has scripts for backing up and restoring the database and uploads. You schedule them yourself, for example with cron, and keep the copies somewhere else.
How do I update?
Pull the new image and restart. Database migrations run by themselves on start, and the guide explains how to go back if one fails.
Which languages does it speak?

The app is in English and Danish, plus 16 more languages in beta, including German, Spanish, French and Swedish. Beta translations have not been reviewed yet, and missing text falls back to English. This site is in English, Danish, German and Spanish.
Is there a mobile app?
The web app works on a phone and can be installed on the home screen. Native apps for iOS and Android are on the way.
Does a self-hosted instance send data anywhere?

Analytics, error reporting, ad tags and release checks are off until you configure them. The one request that leaves by default is when you open the API reference, which loads its viewer from jsDelivr. The telemetry list in the docs names every connection and the setting behind it.
Which accounting systems does it work with?
Billy, Dinero and e-conomic, which are Danish. Every invoice is also available as a PDF.
How is TimeWren related to TimeTrack?
TimeTrack is the Danish product at timetrack.dk that TimeWren grew out of. It is the same code under a new name.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data Mahope collects when you use timewren.com and TimeWren Cloud, how we use it, who we share it with and what rights you have.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: TimeWren Cloud is run by Mahope (CVR 39413892), Denmark. We are the data controller for the personal data in your account. If you use TimeWren Cloud for data about other people, such as employees or your clients, we are your data processor instead, under the data processing agreement in [the terms](terms).

sections.title: 2. What we collect
items: **Account details:** name, email, company name and phone number (optional).
**Usage data:** time entries, client details, projects, invoices and tasks.
**Payment data:** subscriptions are paid through Alunta, which handles card details. We never receive your full card number.
**Calendar data:** calendar events, only if you connect a calendar.
**Technical data:** IP address, browser type, device type and error reports.

sections.title: 3. How we use your data
items: To provide and maintain TimeWren Cloud.
To process payments and manage subscriptions.
To send transactional emails (confirmations, invoices, password resets).
To answer support requests.
To provide AI features, only if you turn them on (section 6).
To monitor and fix technical problems.
To meet legal obligations.

sections.title: 4. Sub-processors we always use
paragraphs: We only share data with third parties when it is needed to run the service. These sub-processors are used for every TimeWren Cloud account:
items: **Hetzner Online GmbH (Germany):** server, database, files, backups and our own mail server. The database is in Nuremberg, Germany, and files and backups are in Helsinki, Finland. Both are in the EU.

**Resend, Inc. (USA):** sends emails from TimeWren Cloud (login links, notifications, reminders) and receives emails you forward to it. Resend's EU region in Ireland. Basis: EU standard contractual clauses and the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

**Functional Software, Inc. / Sentry (USA):** error reporting. A report can contain a user ID, the URL and technical details; default personal data collection is turned off. Basis: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, with EU standard contractual clauses as a fallback.
**Discord Inc. (USA):** internal operations messages to us, including name and email when a user is created. Basis: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and EU standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: 5. Services you choose to connect
paragraphs: These are only used when you or your users turn them on. They process data under your own agreement with the provider:
items: **Login with Microsoft (Entra ID), Google, Apple, GitHub or Discord:** we receive your name and email from the provider.
**Google Calendar and iCloud calendar:** calendar sync when you connect a calendar.
**SMS login (MessageBird):** only if you choose phone login. We send your phone number and a one-time code by SMS.
**Push notifications (650 Industries, Inc. / Expo, USA):** to the mobile app, forwarded through Apple Push Notification Service or Firebase Cloud Messaging. Basis: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
**AI provider you choose (for example OpenAI or Anthropic):** only when a user enters their own API key (section 6).
**Billy, Dinero, e-conomic and TimeOps:** bookkeeping, invoicing and import, when you connect your accounting system.
**Slack, Microsoft Teams and Discord webhooks:** notifications to your own channels, when you create a webhook. Webhook URLs are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM).
after: We never sell your data. We do not use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel or other third-party tracking tools.

sections.title: 6. AI features
items: AI features (task suggestions, time estimates, prioritisation and categorisation) are off by default.
They only work when a user enters their own API key for an AI provider under Settings. TimeWren Cloud has no shared AI key.
Only the data needed is sent (task texts and time entries), never passwords, payment details or personal messages.
You can turn AI features off at any time under Settings.

sections.title: 7. Google user data
paragraphs: When you connect Google Calendar, TimeWren Cloud gets access to data from your Google account through Google's APIs:
items: **What we access:** by default only read access to your calendar (calendar.readonly) and the email address of your Google account (userinfo.email). We read your list of calendars and the events in the calendars you choose: title, time, duration, description, location and your response status. We only use the email address to show which Google account is connected.

**Write access is optional:** only if you turn on a feature that writes, we ask for access to create and change events (calendar.events). It is only used to create, update and delete the events you ask TimeWren to make: time blocks for tasks and exported time entries. We never change or delete other events in your calendar.

**How we use it:** to show your meetings in TimeWren so you can turn them into time entries, suggest free time for tasks and give you an overview of your day. We do not use Google data for advertising, do not sell it and do not use it to train AI models.

**Sharing:** Google data is not shared with anyone other than the processors needed to run the service (hosting at Hetzner in the EU). If you have turned on AI features yourself, titles and times of events that are not yet registered are sent to your AI provider to suggest projects and time entries.

**Storage and deletion:** events and access tokens are stored on our servers in the EU and transferred encrypted. Google access tokens are also stored encrypted in the database (AES-256-GCM). If you disconnect under Settings, Integrations, we delete your tokens and the events we fetched from Google. You can also remove TimeWren's access in your [Google account](https://myaccount.google.com/connections).
after: TimeWren's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the [Google API Services User Data Policy](https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements.

sections.title: 8. How long we keep your data
paragraphs: We keep your data as long as you have an active account. If you delete your account, we delete or anonymise your personal data within 30 days, unless the law requires us to keep it longer (for example 5 years for bookkeeping records under the Danish Bookkeeping Act).
items: **Login sessions:** 7 days
**Payment events:** 90 days
**Error reports (Sentry):** 90 days
**Bookkeeping records:** up to 5 years

sections.title: 9. Your rights
paragraphs: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, correct and delete your data, to export it (data portability) and to object to processing. To use your rights, email {email}. You can also complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency ([Datatilsynet](https://www.datatilsynet.dk)).

sections.title: 10. Security
items: TLS encryption for all data in transit.
Access tokens, API keys and passwords for integrations are stored encrypted in the database (AES-256-GCM).
Encrypted database backups.
Regular security updates.
Access control and authentication.

sections.title: 11. Cookies
paragraphs: timewren.com sets no cookies. TimeWren Cloud only uses strictly necessary cookies for login and sessions. We use no marketing or third-party tracking cookies. If we turn on statistics, they use our own self-hosted Plausible at Hetzner in the EU, which is cookieless and stores no personal data.

sections.title: 12. Self-hosted installations
paragraphs: This policy does not cover TimeWren installations that someone else runs on their own server. A self-hosted installation sends no time entries, clients or invoices to Mahope. Whoever runs it is the data controller (or processor) for the data in it and is responsible for its security, backups, sub-processors and privacy policy. The self-hosting guide lists what the default build loads from third parties.

sections.title: 13. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy. We will tell you about significant changes by email or in TimeWren Cloud.

sections.title: 14. Contact

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use TimeWren Cloud. Please read them carefully.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
paragraphs: By creating an account and using TimeWren Cloud you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, you may not use the service.

sections.title: 2. The service
paragraphs: TimeWren Cloud is the hosted version of TimeWren, run by Mahope (CVR 39413892), Denmark. It offers:
items: Time tracking and prepaid hours
Project and client management
Invoicing and reports
Integrations, including Danish accounting tools (Billy, Dinero, e-conomic) and the Danish company register (CVR)

sections.title: 3. Open-source software and self-hosting
paragraphs: The TimeWren software is open source. It is covered by its own licence (AGPL-3.0, the browser extension MIT), not by these terms. These terms only cover TimeWren Cloud. They do not cover installations that someone else runs on their own server: whoever runs a self-hosted installation is responsible for it, for the data in it and for the terms that apply to its users. Mahope has no access to self-hosted installations and makes no availability, backup or support commitments for them.

sections.title: 4. Accounts
paragraphs: You are responsible for:
items: Keeping your login details secure
All activity under your account
Giving correct and up-to-date information
Telling us at once if your account is used without permission

sections.title: 5. Prices and payment
items: **Plans and prices:** the current plans and prices are on the [pricing page](pricing).
**Yearly payment:** costs the same as 10 months (2 months free).
**Trial:** 30 days free, no card required and no commitment.
**Currency and VAT:** prices exclude VAT. Subscriptions are billed in Danish kroner (DKK). Prices shown in EUR or USD are billed in DKK.
**Payment:** monthly or yearly in advance by card.

sections.title: 6. AI features
paragraphs: TimeWren Cloud has optional AI features (task suggestions, time estimates, categorisation). They only work when you enter a key for an AI provider under Settings. When you use them:
items: AI features are off by default and need your active choice
Relevant task texts and time data are sent to the AI provider you chose, never passwords, payment details or personal messages
AI suggestions are guidance and can be wrong. You are responsible for checking and approving them before use
We are not responsible for the accuracy of AI-generated content
You can turn AI features off at any time

sections.title: 7. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You may not use TimeWren Cloud to:
items: Share illegal content or infringe the rights of others
Send spam or phishing emails
Try to hack or compromise the system
Use the service for illegal purposes
Create several free accounts to get around limits

sections.title: 8. Your data
paragraphs: You keep all rights to your data. We do not own the data you put into the service. At any time you can:
items: Download all your data as one file under Settings, Import and export, also without a paid subscription. In a team, owners and administrators can download the whole team's data, and each member can download their own
Delete your account and all its data
Move your data to another platform

sections.title: 9. Data processing agreement
paragraphs: If you use TimeWren Cloud for personal data about others, such as employees, clients or contact persons, you are the data controller and Mahope is your data processor. This section is the data processing agreement under Article 28 of the GDPR and is part of these terms. It applies to all plans.
items: **Purpose and nature:** we process the data to provide, run, maintain, secure and support TimeWren Cloud for you: time, absence and timesheet records, your clients, contact persons, projects, tasks, prepaid hours and invoice data, approvals, notifications and reports, the client portal when you turn it on, exports to your payroll and accounting systems, login (including Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on), backups, troubleshooting, security monitoring and support.
**Data subjects:** your employees, managers and administrators, external consultants you add, your clients and their contact persons, client portal users and senders of emails you forward or connect.

**Personal data:** names, email addresses, phone numbers, employee details and working hours, time and absence records, timesheet status and approval history; for your clients and contact persons: name, email, phone, address, company number, notes, rates, invoices and prepaid hours; content of tasks and emails you create, forward or connect; IP addresses and logs from logins and actions.

**Special categories:** absence types such as sickness, child's sickness and parental leave can reveal health data. We only process them as an absence category and period. Do not enter health details in free text, and instruct your users not to.
**National identification numbers** (such as Danish CPR numbers) are not processed in TimeWren Cloud. You may not enter them.

**Instructions:** we only process data on your documented instructions. This agreement, your configuration and your use of the features are the instructions. We tell you at once if we believe an instruction breaks data protection law.

**Confidentiality and security:** everyone with access to the data is bound by confidentiality. We apply the security measures in section 10 of the [privacy policy](privacy), matched to the risk (GDPR Article 32).

**Assistance:** we help you meet your obligations towards data subjects (Articles 12 to 23) and under Articles 32 to 36. Every user can download their own data under Settings, Import and export. Other requests are handled by support within 10 working days.

**Personal data breaches:** we notify you without undue delay and no later than 48 hours after becoming aware of a breach affecting your data. The notice goes to your registered administrators and includes the information in Article 33(3) as far as possible. We help you notify the supervisory authority and, where relevant, the data subjects.

**Sub-processors:** you give general authorisation to the sub-processors listed in sections 4 and 5 of the [privacy policy](privacy). We give at least 30 days' notice by email to your administrators before adding or replacing one. You can object with reasons before the deadline. If we cannot find a solution, you can cancel your subscription at the end of the notice period at no extra cost. We impose the same data protection obligations on our sub-processors and remain fully responsible for them. Services you choose to connect process data under your own agreement with the provider.

**Transfers outside the EU:** your database, files and backups are stored in the EU (Germany and Finland). Where a sub-processor processes data outside the EU/EEA, we make sure there is a valid transfer basis (GDPR Chapter V), such as the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or EU standard contractual clauses.

**Your obligations:** you make sure the processing has a legal basis, that data subjects are informed and that your instructions are lawful. You manage your users' access and roles, including removing people who leave, and the integrations and single sign-on settings you set up.

**Audits:** once a year, with at least 30 days' written notice, you can audit our compliance with this agreement yourself or through an independent third party. Instead, we can provide our own security documentation, audit reports from sub-processors and answers to your written questionnaire. You pay your own audit costs; our time beyond 8 hours a year is billed at our hourly rate.

**Duration and deletion:** the agreement applies as long as we process personal data for you. Owners and administrators can download all your data as one file at any time. After your subscription ends you can still download it for 30 days. Then we delete all your personal data unless the law requires otherwise. Data in backups is deleted when the backup expires, no later than 30 days after deletion. You can ask us to delete your organisation and all its data earlier.

**Audit log:** the organisation's audit log of time entries and corrections can help you document compliance with working-time recording rules. Any duty to keep it (for example 5 years under Danish law) is yours. Download it with your export before your subscription ends.

**Liability and law:** liability follows GDPR Article 82 and the limits in these terms, except for loss caused by intent or gross negligence. Danish law applies and disputes are settled at our place of business, unless mandatory law says otherwise.

sections.title: 10. Service level
paragraphs: We aim to provide:
items: 99.9% uptime per year
Daily automatic backups of your data
Support replies within 24 hours
after: We announce planned maintenance at least 48 hours in advance.

sections.title: 11. Ending the agreement
items: **Your cancellation:** you can cancel at any time from your account. You keep access until the end of the period you have paid for.
**Our cancellation:** we may suspend or close your account with 30 days' notice if you break these terms.

**If TimeWren Cloud closes:** you get an email at least 6 months before. Until then you can download all your data as one file, including attachments, audit log and approval history. If you have paid in advance for a period after the closure, we refund the unused part. Your data is then deleted under section 9, also in backups.

sections.title: 12. Disclaimer and liability
paragraphs: TimeWren Cloud is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for:
items: Loss of data or income
Indirect or consequential loss
Third-party integrations that fail
The accuracy of AI-generated suggestions, estimates or categorisations
after: Our total liability is limited to the amount you have paid in the last 12 months.

sections.title: 13. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms. For significant changes, including changes to the data processing agreement, we email you at least 30 days in advance.

sections.title: 14. Law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Danish law. Disputes are settled by the Danish courts. Consumers keep any mandatory rights under the law of their own country.
